headline: Factories in Orenburg Region Find Solid Ground: Federal Center Hands the Region the Keys to Future Development
summary: A preferential loan of 1.9 billion rubles will fund infrastructure development in the Orenburzhye special economic zone. The financing covers 27 residents of the zone.
why: Special economic zones offer tax and financing incentives to manufacturers, shaping regional industrial investment. Investors track such regional support as an indicator of industrial capacity growth.
